scope: Shared R1 PDF generator; opt-in pilot G04 full only
request: Sửa bộ sinh dùng chung theo quyết định hiện hành, cập nhật cổng kiểm, dựng thử G04; chưa commit/xuất bản
root_causes: R1 inherited the D0 body font override; text roles must be explicit per print profile.
The package projection omitted native variation-table divs and did not consume shared table role widths.
The web figure scale was reused for print rather than a physical print label target.
Heading hierarchy and pre-heading anchors produced flat structure, wrong page references and orphan parent headings.
The old gate verified existence of links/fonts/assets without verifying their actual printed role, dimensions, data and target page.

resolved_contract.body: STIX Two Text 11 pt, leading 16 pt
resolved_contract.headings: Be Vietnam Pro; section/subsection hierarchy and printed contents
resolved_contract.graphs: Use current paired vector PDF with the adopted lesson-g03 geometry; uniform scale 11/12.8 to obtain 11 pt source labels. Do not regenerate vectors or stretch to page width.
resolved_contract.tables: Shared function profiles; all canonical native variation-table cells preserved; Vietnamese row labels in text mode; captions below tables.
resolved_contract.links: Exact heading anchors placed at typesetting; printed page references checked against the actual destination footer number.
resolved_contract.rollout: course-print-v2 enabled only in G04 production config. Other packages retain existing profile until owner reviews the pilot.

visual_review.method: Rasterized final candidate; reviewed all page contact sheets and enlarged detail pages during layout repair. No physical print or physical QR scan.

next: Chủ trì xem và duyệt bản thử G04 trước khi áp dụng sang các gói hoặc biến thể còn lại.
